data.optimizer_sees: TRAIN ONLY: a fixed seeded 30-of-80 subset of the official train 80 per search seed (train_subset.txt). Maintainer: <=5 failed + <=3 passed of those (task, trial) traces per iteration (evidence.sample); Proposer: all of them, read on demand. Each trace = the task message, the agent's replies + execution outputs, its last reply, plus the common scorer's gold-safe feedback string and the 0/1 trial score. Also the Wiki, skill-impact.md (every gate's verdict, diff and val SCORE: upstream behaviour), skills.json, and (Proposer) the incumbent prompt.md + seed SKILL.md.
data.selects_on: official val 40: k=3 mean per candidate vs r_best (Eq. 4: strict improvement, ties rejected); the baseline r_best is the seed's val mean.
data.val_feedback_to_optimizer: aggregate val means only, via upstream skill-impact.md (incumbent r_best, candidate accuracy, verdict). No val trace, task id or per-task score reaches a role (PaperAgents._rows rejects non-train rows).
data.test: never loaded by the port; the launcher asserts zero overlap of train/val with the official test list and prints counts only

budget.per_iteration: train 30 x 3 = 90 (incumbent) + val 40 x 3 = 120 (only if the proposer did not return no_action) = 210
budget.R_2160: 120 + floor((2160-120)/210) = 9 full iterations (9 x 210 = 1890; 2010 used, 150 left < 210 so the guard stops); an iteration with no_action costs only 90, so more iterations are possible
budget.guard: before each iteration's train phase: train+val must fit, else stop_reason=budget_R
